خُرَاجٌ Pimples, or small swellings or pustules: [a coll. gen. n.:] n. un. with ة: (Mgh, Msb:) or [the kind of pustule termed] دُمَّل, and the like, that come forth upon the body: (Mgh:) or purulent pustules, or imposthumes, (S, K,) that come forth upon the body: (S:) or a spontaneous swelling that comes forth upon the body: or an ulcerous swelling that comes forth upon a beast of the equine kind and upon other animals: pl. [of pauc.] أَخْرِجَةٌ and [of mult.] خِرْجَانٌ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also خَرَاجٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
